class.name: OcgShapeupgradeConvertsurfacetobezierbasis
class.brief_description: Converts a plane, bspline surface, surface of revolution, surface of extrusion, offset surface to grid of bezier basis surface ( bezier surface, surface of revolution based on bezier curve, offset surface based on any previous type).
class.description: ! Converts a plane, bspline surface, surface of revolution, surface ! of extrusion, offset surface to grid of bezier basis surface ( ! bezier surface, ! surface of revolution based on bezier curve, ! offset surface based on any previous type).

method.name: Build
method.description: Splits a list of beziers computed by Compute method according the split values and splitting parameters.

method.name: Compute
method.description: Converts surface into a grid of bezier based surfaces, and stores this grid.

method.name: Segments
method.description: Returns the grid of bezier based surfaces correspondent to original surface.

method.name: SetPlaneMode
method.description: Sets mode for conversion Geom_Plane to Bezier

method.name: SetRevolutionMode
method.description: Sets mode for conversion Geom_SurfaceOfRevolution to Bezier

method.name: SetExtrusionMode
method.description: Sets mode for conversion Geom_SurfaceOfLinearExtrusion to Bezier

method.name: SetBSplineMode
method.description: Sets mode for conversion Geom_BSplineSurface to Bezier
